title: FIELD_VALUES search results must explicitly request SEARCH_FIELD_RV to get per-row ResourceVersion
answers: Why does the /children API return folders without resourceVersion?
Folder search results missing per-item resource version
How to get resourceVersion populated on ResourceSearchRow when using FIELD_VALUES
subresource children items have empty ResourceVersion
body:
Symptom: items returned by folder registry searches (e.g. /children) had no per-item resourceVersion, breaking optimistic concurrency for individual rows.
Root cause: pkg/registry/apis/folders/sub_children.go only requested SEARCH_FIELD_TITLE; with ResultFormat=FIELD_VALUES, resource.ResourceSearchRow.ResourceVersion is only populated by the index when 'rv' (resource.SEARCH_FIELD_RV) is explicitly listed in Fields — unlike RESOURCE_TABLE format which always sets ResourceTableRow.ResourceVersion.
Fix pattern: when switching a search to ResultFormat=FIELD_VALUES and callers need per-row versioning, add resource.SEARCH_FIELD_RV to the request Fields alongside whatever data fields are needed.
Constraints: only applies to ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat=FIELD_VALUES; this requires index-side support merged in #132625 (search storing/populating '_rv'); older servers using RESOURCE_TABLE are unaffected.
applies: Any code building a resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat=FIELD_VALUES that needs ResourceVersion per row.
says: Folder search results don't include individual resource version information for each item
Why don't folder search results include the resource version
Optimistic concurrency control fails because search results lack version numbers
Folder items returned by search are missing their version numbers
search: FIELD_VALUES search results only populate per-row ResourceVersion when resource.SEARCH_FIELD_RV is explicitly listed in the Fields parameter; RESOURCE_TABLE always sets ResourceTableRow.ResourceVersion but FIELD_VALUES requires explicit request. Add resource.SEARCH_FIELD_RV to Fields alongside data fields for any ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat=FIELD_VALUES that needs per-row versioning, as shown in pkg/registry/apis/folders/sub_children.go. This constraint requires index-side support merged in PR #132625 for '_rv' storage and population.
